subject: Commercial qualification: paper flow options & SOC2 open items
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial qualification: paper flow options & SOC2 open items

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to capture so we can move toward procurement: 

Call recap:
- BrightPath is evaluating a POC for automated clinical-notes summarization across 2 product teams (~30 users).
- Main blockers are procurement paperflow and security attestation (SOC 2 Type II + standard DPA).
- You currently process payments on a company card for small vendor purchases, but larger enterprise approvals go through PO/SOW.

Open qualification items / asks for procurement path:
1) Preferred commercial path: PO (standard), card for initial POC, or via marketplace listing? Please confirm which route Procurement will accept for the pilot and for production.
2) Procurement contact: you mentioned a procurement lead — could you share name/email and any PO template?
3) SOC 2 / DPA needs: confirm whether SOC 2 Type II report + signed DPA is sufficient, or whether you need completed security questionnaire attachments/evidence.
4) Timeline target for contracting to start POC (approx dates) and any internal SLAs for vendor onboarding.

Attachments I shared for your review (stubs): SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (attestation report), DPA_Draft_BrightPath.docx (editable DPA). Full security questionnaire lives in the Drive link below.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm procurement path and contact by EOD Monday (12/13).
- We provide a mutual action plan and routing options (PO vs card vs marketplace) + estimated timelines.
- If SOC 2/DPA suffice, procurement can start paperwork in parallel with POC onboarding.

Cc'ing Karthik for commercial terms and Marissa for procurement coordination. Let me know if you'd prefer a 20-min handoffs with Procurement and Legal this week.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (attestation stub), DPA_Draft_BrightPath.docx (draft)

From: Alice Monroe <alice@brightpath.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna@brightpath.ai>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial qualification: paper flow options & SOC2 open items

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers to move this forward: 

1) Procurement path: For the pilot (POC) Procurement prefers a company card or vendor credit card if total spend is under $5k. For production we will require a standard PO + invoice terms (Net 30). We are not planning to onboard via marketplaces for production at this time.

2) Procurement lead/contact: Jenna Park (cc'd) is our procurement manager — she'll own PO templates and legal intake. Jenna, copying our procurement mailbox (procurement@brightpath.ai) — can you confirm next steps on our side?

3) Security gating: SOC 2 Type II + an executed DPA should satisfy our Legal team for vendor onboarding. We do rely on a short security questionnaire (Q1: encryption at rest, Q2: incident reporting SLA, Q3: data retention) — if you can pre-fill answers, that will speed review. We will also request any SOC 2 auditor letter if possible.

4) Timeline: Target is to start the pilot week of Jan 11, 2027. Procurement has a 5–10 business day review for vendors with completed docs; Legal may need an additional week depending on redlines.

Action items from BrightPath:
- Jenna to share PO template and preferred supplier onboarding form (Jenna: can you share by 12/14?).
- We will review the SOC2 stub and DPA and flag any additional evidence requests.

Appreciate you sending the DPA draft — we'll flag comments inline. If helpful, we can do a quick joint call with Procurement + Legal next Tuesday.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Head of Product 
BrightPath.ai
alice@brightpath.ai | +1 (617) 555-2381

(Attachment: none — procurement will request docs via procurement@brightpath.ai)

Thanks Alice and Jenna — great to have clarity. Quick update and proposed MAP so everyone is aligned: 

Summary of decisions:
- Pilot path: company card or vendor card for purchases < $5k (BrightPath).
- Production: PO + Net 30 invoicing. Marketplace not in scope for initial contract.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II + executed DPA + completed security questionnaire will be sufficient to start procurement review.

Proposed mutual action plan (dates):
- 12/14: Jenna shares PO template and supplier onboarding form (BrightPath).
- 12/15: Redwood provides completed security questionnaire + SOC2 attestation + updated DPA (Aditya / Marissa). (Attachment: mutual_action_plan_20261212.xlsx)
- 12/22: BrightPath Legal sends any redlines on DPA; Procurement confirms PO terms.
- 01/11: Target start for pilot onboarding.

Marissa: can you take point on updating the DPA draft for the items Alice highlighted (encryption at rest confirmation, incident reporting SLA, data retention window) and attach the pre-filled questionnaire to the shared Drive? Karthik: can you prepare a short pricing note for the pilot (card-friendly invoice + PO production SKU) so Jenna has numbers for the vendor form?

Jenna / Procurement team: if you prefer, I can upload the requested docs to the Drive link and route a DocuSign package for signature once legal approves. Otherwise we can follow your supplier portal.

Next meeting suggestion: 20 minutes with Procurement + Legal on Wed 12/15 at 10:00am ET to walk the questionnaire and confirm PO template — I can set if that works for you both.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing the logistics so the pilot can start on Jan 11.

Aditya Rao
